description: Refresh the xAI catalog slice from GET /v1/models and reconcile it through the router; returns ok, retained model count and safe discovery outcome.

request_schema.description: Input of a provider's `provider::<id>::refresh_models` — takes no arguments. A struct (not `Value`) keeps the request schema concrete; unknown fields (e.g. the engine-injected `_caller_worker_id`) are ignored.
request_schema.title: RefreshModelsRequest

DiscoveryOutcome.description: Safe discovery categories. No upstream message, team id or URL is retained.

response_schema.description: Extended refresh acknowledgement. The legacy {ok,count} stays unchanged.
response_schema.title: DiscoveryRefreshResponse
